title: AASD: Accelerate Inference by Aligning Speculative Decoding in Multimodal Large Language Models
problem: Autoregressive decoding and long multimodal contexts make MLLM inference expensive.
method_or_artifact: AASD compresses target KV information with a KV Projector and uses Target-Draft Attention for draft alignment.
workload_or_benchmark: Mainstream multimodal LLMs; exact model/task suite unspecified.
metrics: up to 2x inference speedup without accuracy sacrifice; named baseline and hardware unspecified
limits: No hardware identity, model suite, absolute latency, training cost, or accuracy protocol. The draft-alignment mechanism is distinct from hardware scheduling.

title: HybriMoE: Hybrid CPU-GPU Scheduling and Cache Management for Efficient MoE Inference
problem: Unpredictable expert activation complicates CPU/GPU assignment under limited memory.
method_or_artifact: HybriMoE uses dynamic intra-layer scheduling, impact-driven prefetching, and score-based caching.
workload_or_benchmark: MoE inference evaluated on kTransformers and Llama.cpp; models unspecified.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: Hybrid CPU/GPU execution; device identities unspecified.
baselines: kTransformers and Llama.cpp named as evaluation systems; exact baseline configuration unspecified
limits: Description does not establish adversarial testing or connect each speedup to a named configuration.

title: UPVSS: Jointly Managing Vector Similarity Search with Near-Memory Processing Systems
problem: DRAM bandwidth and host-memory movement limit vector similarity search.
method_or_artifact: UPVSS assigns vector-search operations to UPMEM according to its processing capabilities.
workload_or_benchmark: Vector similarity search; dataset identities and recall targets unspecified.
limits: No numerical result, named comparison system, dataset, recall target, or energy measurement in the description.

title: Icarus's Wings: Disabling MoE Offloading Acceleration via a Universal Hidden Prefix Attack
problem: MoE caching/prefetching can be disrupted when locality and routing predictions fail.
method_or_artifact: Icarus uses a gradient-based adversarial prefix embedding, temporal-locality minimization, and expert-prefetch misleading.
workload_or_benchmark: Multi-user GPU-centric MoE offloading across models/devices; exact suite unspecified.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: GPU-centric MoE offloading; access and deployment assumptions need full paper.
baselines: unattacked cached/prefetched MoE execution; exact software baseline unspecified
limits: Not evidence that HybriMoE itself was attacked. Attacker embedding access, transfer conditions, and relevance to ordinary text prompts require verification.

title: CANNON: A CXL-Based Near-Memory Processing Architecture for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search on Real Hardware
problem: Local memory capacity and coarse SSD I/O constrain ANN search.
method_or_artifact: CANNON fully offloads a pipelined ANN flow to real CXL NMP hardware using asynchronous hashing/speculation.
workload_or_benchmark: Large-scale vector datasets; identities and recall targets unspecified.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: Real CXL near-memory processing hardware; configuration unspecified.
metrics: up to two orders of magnitude performance improvement; metric definition and per-baseline conditions missing
limits: No shared dataset/recall target or hardware equivalence with UPVSS; no cross-paper speedup comparison is possible.

title: AHASD: Asynchronous Heterogeneous Architecture for LLM Adaptive Drafting Speculative Decoding on Mobile Devices
problem: Mobile single-NPU/PIM adaptive drafting incurs synchronous idle time and wasted asynchronous drafts.
method_or_artifact: AHASD decouples PIM drafting and NPU verification; entropy/history and timing controls limit invalid work.
workload_or_benchmark: Multiple LLMs and adaptive drafting algorithms; specific suite unspecified.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: LPDDR5-PIM attention/scheduling units with a single mobile NPU.
metrics: up to 4.2x throughput and 5.6x energy efficiency versus GPU-only
1.5x throughput and 1.24x energy efficiency versus GPU+PIM
hardware overhead below 3% of DRAM area
limits: Different hardware and workload from AASD. No shared model/baseline or energy methodology supports cross-edition superiority.
